Draft 1. Two majors (30:10, 30:11b — the perfect passives), one minor (30:12 super omnes). «A tradução conserva, em geral, o conteúdo e as imagens do latim.» Passed 'para sempre não serei envergonhado', 'Nas vossas mãos entrego', 'vós me resgatastes', 'Vós odiais', 'observam vaidades, * em vão', 'as minhas sortes', 'Iluminai', 'fora de mim', 'Por isso', 'Vós a aperfeiçoastes', 'Portai-vos como homens'.

outcomes.remark: MAJOR: the perfect passive made a present state → 'foi perturbado na ira …'
outcomes.reason: Taken with the stylist's order and plural agreement: 'na ira foram perturbados o meu olho, a minha alma e o meu ventre'.

outcomes.remark: MAJOR: 'enfraqueceu' intransitive for the passive → 'foi enfraquecido'
outcomes.reason: Taken in part: the reflexive middle 'se enfraqueceu' (17:37, 26:2b, which he passed); the Greek is active intransitive (ἠσθένησεν) and 'foi enfraquecido' asks for an agent. His form is option 2.

outcomes.remark: MAJOR: 'estão perturbados' for the perfect passive → 'foram perturbados'
minor: 'Entre' loses the comparative of super omnes → 'Mais que todos os meus inimigos'

note: Draft 1. Ten verses; best 30:9, worst 30:12. «O salmo tem sobriedade e imagens fortes, mas algumas construções ainda obrigam a boca a acompanhar a sintaxe latina.» Six taken (in whole or in substance), four refused with options.

outcomes.remark: 'para sempre não' sounds assembled → 'não serei envergonhado para sempre'
outcomes.reason: D23's formula: his order is heard as 'not for ever' (9:19, D27); the blind reader heard draft 1 as 'never'.

outcomes.remark: proparoxytone 'espírito' at the mediant → 'O meu espírito entrego nas vossas mãos'
outcomes.reason: The Compline responsory's order ('In manus tuas, Dómine'); the Latin's own mediant is 'spíritum meum'; an inversion for the cadence.

outcomes.remark: singular verb, interposed phrase, list after → 'Na ira, estão perturbados o meu olho, a minha alma e o meu ventre'
outcomes.reason: His order and plural, with the Latinist's perfect ('foram').

outcomes.remark: 'muito' hangs, not tied to 'afronta' → 'e grande afronta para os meus vizinhos'
outcomes.reason: Taken in substance with 'sobretudo' (MS1932): 'afronta' is not repeated, as the Latin says it once; his line is an option.

outcomes.remark: 'para fora' arrives as an afterthought → 'fugiram para fora, para longe de mim'
outcomes.reason: With one 'para': 'fugiram para fora, longe de mim', which answers 'longe do coração' (a me … a corde).

outcomes.remark: 'deliberaram' sounds like minutes → 'planejaram'
'iluminar a face … sobre' does not fit → 'Fazei brilhar a vossa face'
outcomes.reason: One Greek verb with 118:135, whose colon this repeats word for word (held there twice against the stylist); the blind reader understood it.

outcomes.remark: 'da perturbação' hangs after the pause → 'longe da perturbação dos homens'
'fez maravilhosa' is a calque → 'mostrou de modo maravilhoso a sua misericórdia para comigo'
outcomes.reason: The mirificáre row (4:4, 15:3, 16:7); 'mostrou' is a verb the Latin does not have.

outcomes.remark: two 'com' phrases, 'procedem' bureaucratic → 'retribuirá abundantemente aos que agem com soberba'

note: Draft 1. 49 items, 8 unknown words (exultarei, atribulado, desfaleceu, deliberaram, sortes, Corem, iniquidade, contenda). One wrong first hearing mended: 30:13 'vaso perdido' as a misplaced vase → 'destruído'. Heard rightly: 30:2 'para sempre não serei envergonhado' as 'never', 30:6 'entrego o meu espírito' (entrusting, at death), 30:9, 30:12b 'longe do coração' (out of mind), 30:17 'Iluminai … sobre o vosso servo', 30:20 'escondestes para' (stored up for), 30:23 'fora de mim'. Kept as the Latin's own range: 30:10 'na ira' (own anger first — the Latin names no owner), 30:7 'observam vaidades' (attention to futile things / vanity; 'em vão' with either verb, as the Latin), 30:15 'sortes' (fate / luck), 30:20 'multidão' (people first, then quantity — the multitúdo row), 30:24 'retribuirá' (punishment first, reward second — retribúere is neutral), 30:24 'santos' (canonized saints first — the Latin's word).

outcomes.remark: 'um vaso perdido' likely heard as a vase gone missing
'deliberaram' unknown
'e muito para os meus vizinhos' may be heard as 'many neighbours'
'na ira' heard as the speaker's own anger first
outcomes.reason: The Latin's 'in ira' names no owner (ἐν θυμῷ); the three readings the reader lists are the Latin's.

outcomes.remark: 'sortes' unknown / heard as luck
outcomes.reason: The Latin's plural (lots, portion); 'luck' is close to 'my lot'; the singular and MS1932's 'destino' are options.

outcomes.remark: 'multidão' suggests people first
outcomes.reason: The multitúdo row (5:7b, 5:11b): one word for the Latin's; the reader reached quantity at once.

outcomes.remark: 'Corem' unknown as a verb form
outcomes.reason: erubéscere → corar (glossary, open); evidence added to the row, 'Envergonhem-se' the option.

outcomes.remark: 'contenda' unknown
outcomes.reason: The contradíctio row (17:44); the reader still heard 'verbal quarrels' in the phrase.
